screen.inventory_toolkit.title: Inventory Toolkit

screen.inventory_toolkit.recipe_book.des: Toggle enhanced recipes, favorites, and instant crafting.
screen.inventory_toolkit.loadouts.descri: Build and apply rule-based hotbar presets.
screen.inventory_toolkit.offhand_swapper: Open a secondary hotbar and quickly swap an item into your offhand.
screen.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.descr: Automatically select the best allowed hotbar tool when mining.
screen.inventory_toolkit.transfers.descr: Configure drag and scroll-wheel inventory transfers.
screen.inventory_toolkit.refill.descript: Automatically replace or top up used stacks.
screen.inventory_toolkit.bundles.descrip: Route items into named bundles and browse their contents.
screen.inventory_toolkit.sweeper.descrip: Drop newly collected items using safe rules.
message.inventory_toolkit.busy: Inventory Toolkit is finishing another inventory action. Try again.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.title: Auto Tool Switch
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.categ: Choose when automatic switching is allowed and configure its shortcuts.
Control how the best eligible tool is ranked for the targeted block.
Protect worn tools and choose the tool types and hotbar slots that may be selected.
Use exact identifiers or #tags to include or exclude blocks and tools.
Choose what happens when mining ends and which status messages are shown.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.enabl: Master switch for automatic tool selection.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.activ: The activation/bypass key can be ignored, required, or used as a temporary pause.
Used according to Activation behavior. Left Alt is the default bypass key.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.toggl: Toggles and saves the master switch. Unbound by default.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.allow: When disabled, sneaking prevents an automatic switch.
Creative mode usually does not benefit from a mining tool.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.pause: Do not switch while eating, drawing a bow, blocking, or otherwise using an item.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.corre: Prefer or require tools that can harvest drops which need a correct tool.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.minim: Items slower than this are ignored. 1.01 excludes ordinary hand-speed items.
Avoid switching unless the candidate is this much faster. Correct-tool and strong enchantment preferences can override it.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.loot_: Select no loot preference, Silk Touch, Fortune, or a tool without enchantments.
Use the preference only for speed ties, rank it before speed, or reject nonmatching tools.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.durab: When tools mine equally fast, choose by remaining durability or hotbar order.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.remai: Never select a damageable tool with fewer points remaining. Set 2 to avoid the final breaking hit.
Never select a tool below this remaining percentage. Both durability limits must pass.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.rules: Enter namespaced IDs such as minecraft:stone or tags such as #minecraft:logs. A whitelist with no entries intentionally matches nothing.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.retur: Keep the selected tool or return to the slot held before automatic switching began.
Wait this many ticks after attack is released before returning.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.cance: Cancel the pending return when you select a different hotbar slot yourself.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.show_: Show the chosen tool above the hotbar.
Show whether the module was enabled or disabled with its toggle key.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.inventory: Better recipes, auto tool switching, configurable transfers, hotbar loadouts, offhand swapping, bundle routing, stack refills, and safe inventory sweeping.
